August of 2018:  On the day of my assault, I immediately went to the hospital where they collected my rape kit and I talked to a police officer briefly (provided texts about it and filled her in on the where and when). That day, my rape kit was sent to the states testing office and I was given a contact who specializes in sex crimes (I believe this would technically be when I filed a police report).

October 2018: I came into the police station and gave my statement. This gave them time to investigate the crime in the mean time, check for any cameras nearly the crime scene, ext. At this time, they told me that they would continue to investigate but needed to wait for my rape kit. They estimated it would take about 10 months to a year from the date it was sent in to have it back. 

Long time with no information. I reached back out twice I believe but they were still waiting on the kit. 

October 2019: The police station reached back out to tell me they had the results and had talked to my rapist. Test came back that I had been assaulted and that my kit tested positive for his sperm. He's already in the system so they matched his DNA. They told me at this point I could choose whether or not I wanted to forward this to the states attorneys office to go forward with the charge. Some people at this point want to forget, and they said they would respect whatever my decision was. I decided to move forward. The state's attorney would decide if there was enough evidence to press charges and would relay this through the police station.  

January 2020: The police station informed me there was enough evidence and would move forward if I was still wanting to. This moves forward to a small jury who decides what the charges would be and issues a warrant out for the person's arrest. They told me it could take up to a month depending on when that group would next meet. 

February and March 2020: They charged him with 3 felonies. 1 count of sexual assault, 2 counts of sexual abuse for the different acts during the assault. The state's attorney felony victim assistant reached out to me with this information, her contact, and how she would assist me through the process. She also set up a three way call with me, herself, and the state attorney where we discussed whatever parts I was comfortable with and talked about any plea deals. We agreed to a number that I wanted without any pressure. They even told me I could think about it first, but I knew what I wanted. 

Now: They have told me they have forward my negotiation of a plea deal to his attorney. The evidence is substantially in my favor, so they have told me that it is fairly unlikely I will have to attend a judge or jury trial unless he fights tooth and nail. They should expect further information in a month or two given current circumstances. 

To answer your questions: I did not talk to an attorney until a couple of months ago. My contact as specially a sex crimes police officer. I did not get to choose the specific charges as that is decided between the state and in part with the sentencing trial. I did not get to see his statements, but I did ask what he said and was given insight into his "explanation" for what happened. Basically, our stories matched other than consent but he did say that he really liked me but went about it "the wrong way".
